instructions.task: Identify the single intent of this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat.
guidance: Pick the option whose meaning best matches what the customer is asking about or reporting.
Distinguish carefully by the object (card payment, cash withdrawal, transfer, top-up, direct debit) and by the problem (fee, pending, declined, failed, not recognised, wrong exchange rate, reverted).

activate_my_card.meaning: Customer wants to activate a card they received, or cannot activate it.
examples: How do I activate my card?
i cant seem to activate card

age_limit.meaning: Minimum or maximum age to open/use an account; accounts for children or teenagers.
examples: What is the age limit?
Can I open an account for my kids?

apple_pay_or_google_pay.meaning: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them.
examples: Does Apple Pay work with my card?
Can I top up with Google Pay?

atm_support.meaning: Which or where ATMs accept the card; finding an ATM.
examples: What is the closest ATM?
Which ATMs can I use with this card?

automatic_top_up.meaning: The automatic / auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how it works, turning it on or off.
examples: Is auto top up available?

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: A bank transfer INTO the customer's own account was made or is expected, but the balance has not updated / the money is not showing.
examples: I did a transfer but the balance is the same.
My transfer into my account isn't showing up.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.notes: Includes 'How long does a transfer from the UK take? I made one and it isn't showing up' and 'I transferred money but my balance didn't update' regardless of direction: mention of the balance or of a made transfer not showing up decides it.

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.meaning: A cheque or cash deposit was made but the balance has not updated / the funds are not showing or are slow.
examples: I deposited a cheque but I don't see the funds.
My cheque is slow to cash

beneficiary_not_allowed.meaning: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a beneficiary is not allowed.
examples: Why is my beneficiary not allowed?

cancel_transfer.meaning: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/payment they made (e.g. sent by mistake, wrong account).
examples: Is it possible to cancel my transfer?
I need a transaction reversed.

card_about_to_expire.meaning: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring/expired card.
examples: My card is about to expire, how do I get a new one?

card_acceptance.meaning: Where or in which shops/situations the card can be used or is accepted.
examples: Can I use my card everywhere?
Which stores accept this card?

card_arrival.meaning: An ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent.
examples: My card still hasn't arrived.
I need to track the card sent to me.

card_delivery_estimate.meaning: How long card delivery takes, delivery by a certain date, expediting card delivery.
examples: How long does it take to get my card?
Can I get my card fast tracked?

card_linking.meaning: Linking/adding a card to the app or account, making a received card show up in the app.
examples: Where in the app do I link a new card?

card_not_working.meaning: The physical card does not work (in shops, at ATMs, generally) without a specific decline/contactless issue being the focus.
examples: My card isn't working.
I have not been able to use this card.

card_payment_fee_charged.meaning: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; why card payments carry fees.
examples: Why was I charged a fee for a card payment?
I was charged extra for making a purchase with my card

card_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A card payment/purchase on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not make.
examples: There is a card payment I'm not familiar with.
I didn't make a payment that shows in my app.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.meaning: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
examples: I purchased something overseas and the incorrect exchange rate was applied.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.notes: Also short complaints that the rate the customer got/was charged is wrong or incorrect, when no cash withdrawal is mentioned.

examples: The ATM stole my card!

cash_withdrawal_charge.meaning: Fees charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
examples: Why did you charge me extra when I withdrew cash?
Is there a fee for ATM withdrawals?
cash_withdrawal_charge.notes: Fees for cash withdrawals in general. If the withdrawal is abroad, at a foreign ATM or in a foreign currency, choose wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal instead.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.meaning: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
examples: The app says I took out cash but I didn't!

change_pin.meaning: Changing or resetting the card PIN.
examples: How do I change my PIN?

compromised_card.meaning: Card or card details compromised: someone else is using the card, fraudulent use, wants card frozen/blocked for security.
examples: Someone is using my card without my knowledge!
My card details were stolen and used.
Contactless isn't working.

country_support.meaning: Which countries the service/account is available in or supports.
examples: Supported countries
Can I use the service if I live in Spain?
Why was my card payment declined?
My card was declined online.

declined_cash_withdrawal.meaning: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined/not authorised.
examples: My ATM withdrawal was declined.
I tried to transfer but it was declined

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise.
examples: There's a direct debit I didn't set up.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.notes: Also a vague unknown 'charge' on the account that the customer doesn't know or understand, when nothing says it was a card payment, purchase or 'payment' and it is not a small extra amount like £1 (e.g. 'I do not know what this charge is for', 'I have an unknown charge'). Not when the customer says it is a charge they did not make.

disposable_card_limits.meaning: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, amounts).
examples: What are the limits of disposable cards?

edit_personal_details.meaning: Changing personal details/information on the account (name, address, etc.).
examples: How do I change my address?
Are there fees for exchanging currency?

exchange_rate.meaning: What exchange rates are used, where to see them, how they are set.
examples: What is the exchange rate for EUR?
exchange_rate.notes: Questions about what the rates are; NOT complaints that a rate already applied was wrong (those are card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate or wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal).

exchange_via_app.meaning: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app, or which currencies can be exchanged.
examples: How can I exchange currencies in the app?

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexplained extra charge or small extra amount (e.g. an extra £1) on the statement, not tied to a specific named fee type.
examples: Why have I been charged an extra £1?
There's an extra fee on my statement.
extra_charge_on_statement.notes: Includes small extra amounts like an extra £1/€1/$1 or 'why was I charged' without saying for what.

failed_transfer.meaning: A transfer failed or did not go through.
examples: I attempted a transfer, but it failed.
Why do my transfers keep failing?
failed_transfer.notes: Also an error when trying to make a large payment such as a flat purchase or mortgage payment (not a card purchase).

fiat_currency_support.meaning: Which fiat currencies the account can hold, receive or support.
examples: What currencies can my account be in?

get_disposable_virtual_card.meaning: How to get/create a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
examples: How do I get a disposable virtual card?

get_physical_card.meaning: Getting the PIN for a new physical card, or obtaining the physical card itself after it was issued.
examples: Where do I find the PIN for my new card?
I have not received my pin yet

getting_spare_card.meaning: Getting an additional / spare / second card.
examples: Can I get a second card?

getting_virtual_card.meaning: How to get or find a (non-disposable) virtual card.
examples: How do I get a virtual card?

lost_or_stolen_card.meaning: The card itself was lost or stolen, or found again after being lost.
examples: My card has been stolen.
I lost my card.

lost_or_stolen_phone.meaning: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left somewhere, affecting app access.
examples: My phone was stolen.

order_physical_card.meaning: How to order a physical card, its cost, where it can be shipped.
examples: How do I order a physical card?

passcode_forgotten.meaning: Forgot the app passcode/login code; resetting it.
examples: I've forgotten my passcode.

pending_card_payment.meaning: A card payment/purchase is showing as pending.
examples: Why is my card payment still pending?

pending_cash_withdrawal.meaning: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending / in progress.
examples: What does it mean when a cash withdrawal is pending?

pending_top_up.meaning: A top-up is pending or taking a long time to complete.
examples: My top-up appears to be pending.

pending_transfer.meaning: A transfer the customer sent is showing as pending.
examples: I did a transfer but its still pending
pending_transfer.notes: Also long waits for a transfer the customer made that is still in progress.

pin_blocked.meaning: Card PIN blocked after wrong attempts; unblocking.
examples: I entered the wrong PIN too many times.

receiving_money.meaning: How to receive money / get paid into the account from others.
examples: Can my friend send me money?

Refund_not_showing_up.meaning: A refund was promised/requested but has not appeared in the account.
examples: My refund hasn't shown up.
I am still waiting for a refund

request_refund.meaning: Wants to get a refund for a purchase; how refunds work.
examples: How do I get a refund for something I bought?

reverted_card_payment?.meaning: A card payment was reverted / returned / the money came back to the account.
examples: I made a payment but it was returned.

supported_cards_and_currencies.meaning: Which card types (e.g. credit cards) and currencies are supported for topping up or payments.
examples: Which cards can I use to top up?
Can you delete my account?

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.meaning: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
examples: Is there a fee to top up by bank transfer?

top_up_by_card_charge.meaning: Fees for topping up by card.
examples: What is the fee for topping up by card?

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.meaning: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque: whether and how.
examples: How do I deposit cash?
Can I top up with a cheque?

top_up_failed.meaning: A top-up failed or did not go through.
examples: My top-up failed.

top_up_limits.meaning: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency.
examples: Is there a top-up limit?

top_up_reverted.meaning: A top-up was reverted, or the top-up money disappeared/was taken back.
examples: My top-up was reverted.

topping_up_by_card.meaning: How to top up using a card; problems topping up with a card.
examples: How do I top up with my card?

transaction_charged_twice.meaning: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge.
examples: I was charged twice!

transfer_fee_charged.meaning: A fee was charged on a transfer.
examples: Why was my transfer charged a fee?

transfer_into_account.meaning: How to transfer money into the account (from another bank account).
examples: How do I transfer money into my account?

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: A transfer the customer sent has not been received by the recipient.
examples: My friend hasn't received the money I sent.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient.notes: Also a sent transfer that is 'taking too long' or 'not there yet' on the other side.

transfer_timing.meaning: How long transfers take to arrive / be available.
examples: How long does a transfer take?
transfer_timing.notes: Only purely general questions about how long transfers take (e.g. from the US or Europe) with no specific transfer reported missing. If the customer says they made a transfer and it is not showing up / balance unchanged, choose balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer instead.

unable_to_verify_identity.meaning: Identity verification failing or the customer cannot complete it.
examples: The app failed to verify my id.

verify_my_identity.meaning: How to verify identity, what documents are needed, how long it takes.
examples: How do I verify my identity?

verify_source_of_funds.meaning: Showing/verifying the source of funds, where money comes from.
examples: Do I need to prove my source of funds?

verify_top_up.meaning: Verifying a top-up / top-up card, the verification code for a top-up.
examples: Where can I find the verification code for a top-up?

virtual_card_not_working.meaning: A virtual card does not work.
examples: My virtual card isn't working.

visa_or_mastercard.meaning: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing one.
examples: Is the card Visa or Mastercard?

why_verify_identity.meaning: Why identity verification or personal information is needed.
examples: Why do I need to verify my identity?

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.meaning: ATM dispensed less/wrong amount of cash than requested or recorded.
examples: The ATM gave me less cash than I asked for.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.meaning: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.
examples: I got the wrong exchange rate on my ATM withdrawal.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.notes: Also covers questions about the cost, rate or extra fees of withdrawing cash abroad / at foreign ATMs / in another currency (e.g. 'Can I withdraw abroad without extra fees?', 'I was charged too much for a withdrawal on holiday').

disposable_card_limits.definition: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, amounts).
sample_messages: What are the limits of disposable cards?

top_up_reverted.definition: A top-up was reverted, or the top-up money disappeared/was taken back.
sample_messages: My top-up was reverted.

edit_personal_details.definition: Changing personal details/information on the account (name, address, etc.).
sample_messages: How do I change my address?

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.definition: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
sample_messages: The app says I took out cash but I didn't!

order_physical_card.definition: How to order a physical card, its cost, where it can be shipped.
sample_messages: How do I order a physical card?

card_acceptance.definition: Where or in which shops/situations the card can be used or is accepted.
sample_messages: Can I use my card everywhere?
Which stores accept this card?

card_linking.definition: Linking/adding a card to the app or account, making a received card show up in the app.
sample_messages: Where in the app do I link a new card?

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.definition: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise.
sample_messages: There's a direct debit I didn't set up.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.labelling_rule: Also a vague unknown 'charge' on the account that the customer doesn't know or understand, when nothing says it was a card payment, purchase or 'payment' and it is not a small extra amount like £1 (e.g. 'I do not know what this charge is for', 'I have an unknown charge'). Not when the customer says it is a charge they did not make.

top_up_limits.definition: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency.
sample_messages: Is there a top-up limit?

exchange_rate.definition: What exchange rates are used, where to see them, how they are set.
sample_messages: What is the exchange rate for EUR?
exchange_rate.labelling_rule: Questions about what the rates are; NOT complaints that a rate already applied was wrong (those are card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate or wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal).

pending_top_up.definition: A top-up is pending or taking a long time to complete.
sample_messages: My top-up appears to be pending.

age_limit.definition: Minimum or maximum age to open/use an account; accounts for children or teenagers.
sample_messages: What is the age limit?
Can I open an account for my kids?

getting_spare_card.definition: Getting an additional / spare / second card.
sample_messages: Can I get a second card?

lost_or_stolen_phone.definition: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left somewhere, affecting app access.
sample_messages: My phone was stolen.

compromised_card.definition: Card or card details compromised: someone else is using the card, fraudulent use, wants card frozen/blocked for security.
sample_messages: Someone is using my card without my knowledge!
My card details were stolen and used.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.definition: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
sample_messages: I purchased something overseas and the incorrect exchange rate was applied.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.labelling_rule: Also short complaints that the rate the customer got/was charged is wrong or incorrect, when no cash withdrawal is mentioned.

passcode_forgotten.definition: Forgot the app passcode/login code; resetting it.
sample_messages: I've forgotten my passcode.

exchange_via_app.definition: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app, or which currencies can be exchanged.
sample_messages: How can I exchange currencies in the app?

verify_source_of_funds.definition: Showing/verifying the source of funds, where money comes from.
sample_messages: Do I need to prove my source of funds?

visa_or_mastercard.definition: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing one.
sample_messages: Is the card Visa or Mastercard?

transfer_timing.definition: How long transfers take to arrive / be available.
sample_messages: How long does a transfer take?
transfer_timing.labelling_rule: Only purely general questions about how long transfers take (e.g. from the US or Europe) with no specific transfer reported missing. If the customer says they made a transfer and it is not showing up / balance unchanged, choose balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer instead.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.definition: ATM dispensed less/wrong amount of cash than requested or recorded.
sample_messages: The ATM gave me less cash than I asked for.

reverted_card_payment?.definition: A card payment was reverted / returned / the money came back to the account.
sample_messages: I made a payment but it was returned.

extra_charge_on_statement.definition: An unexplained extra charge or small extra amount (e.g. an extra £1) on the statement, not tied to a specific named fee type.
sample_messages: Why have I been charged an extra £1?
There's an extra fee on my statement.
extra_charge_on_statement.labelling_rule: Includes small extra amounts like an extra £1/€1/$1 or 'why was I charged' without saying for what.

virtual_card_not_working.definition: A virtual card does not work.
sample_messages: My virtual card isn't working.

topping_up_by_card.definition: How to top up using a card; problems topping up with a card.
sample_messages: How do I top up with my card?
The ATM stole my card!

cancel_transfer.definition: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/payment they made (e.g. sent by mistake, wrong account).
sample_messages: Is it possible to cancel my transfer?
I need a transaction reversed.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.definition: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque: whether and how.
sample_messages: How do I deposit cash?
Can I top up with a cheque?

apple_pay_or_google_pay.definition: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them.
sample_messages: Does Apple Pay work with my card?
Can I top up with Google Pay?

transaction_charged_twice.definition: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge.
sample_messages: I was charged twice!

pending_transfer.definition: A transfer the customer sent is showing as pending.
sample_messages: I did a transfer but its still pending
pending_transfer.labelling_rule: Also long waits for a transfer the customer made that is still in progress.

sample_messages: Why was my card payment declined?
My card was declined online.

pin_blocked.definition: Card PIN blocked after wrong attempts; unblocking.
sample_messages: I entered the wrong PIN too many times.

supported_cards_and_currencies.definition: Which card types (e.g. credit cards) and currencies are supported for topping up or payments.
sample_messages: Which cards can I use to top up?

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.definition: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
sample_messages: Is there a fee to top up by bank transfer?

get_disposable_virtual_card.definition: How to get/create a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
sample_messages: How do I get a disposable virtual card?

Refund_not_showing_up.definition: A refund was promised/requested but has not appeared in the account.
sample_messages: My refund hasn't shown up.
I am still waiting for a refund

getting_virtual_card.definition: How to get or find a (non-disposable) virtual card.
sample_messages: How do I get a virtual card?

card_not_working.definition: The physical card does not work (in shops, at ATMs, generally) without a specific decline/contactless issue being the focus.
sample_messages: My card isn't working.
I have not been able to use this card.

verify_top_up.definition: Verifying a top-up / top-up card, the verification code for a top-up.
sample_messages: Where can I find the verification code for a top-up?

fiat_currency_support.definition: Which fiat currencies the account can hold, receive or support.
sample_messages: What currencies can my account be in?

request_refund.definition: Wants to get a refund for a purchase; how refunds work.
sample_messages: How do I get a refund for something I bought?

atm_support.definition: Which or where ATMs accept the card; finding an ATM.
sample_messages: What is the closest ATM?
Which ATMs can I use with this card?

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.definition: A transfer the customer sent has not been received by the recipient.
sample_messages: My friend hasn't received the money I sent.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient.labelling_rule: Also a sent transfer that is 'taking too long' or 'not there yet' on the other side.

failed_transfer.definition: A transfer failed or did not go through.
sample_messages: I attempted a transfer, but it failed.
Why do my transfers keep failing?
failed_transfer.labelling_rule: Also an error when trying to make a large payment such as a flat purchase or mortgage payment (not a card purchase).

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.definition: A bank transfer INTO the customer's own account was made or is expected, but the balance has not updated / the money is not showing.
sample_messages: I did a transfer but the balance is the same.
My transfer into my account isn't showing up.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.labelling_rule: Includes 'How long does a transfer from the UK take? I made one and it isn't showing up' and 'I transferred money but my balance didn't update' regardless of direction: mention of the balance or of a made transfer not showing up decides it.

card_payment_fee_charged.definition: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; why card payments carry fees.
sample_messages: Why was I charged a fee for a card payment?
I was charged extra for making a purchase with my card

transfer_into_account.definition: How to transfer money into the account (from another bank account).
sample_messages: How do I transfer money into my account?

declined_cash_withdrawal.definition: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined/not authorised.
sample_messages: My ATM withdrawal was declined.
Can you delete my account?

card_arrival.definition: An ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent.
sample_messages: My card still hasn't arrived.
I need to track the card sent to me.

automatic_top_up.definition: The automatic / auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how it works, turning it on or off.
sample_messages: Is auto top up available?
I tried to transfer but it was declined

transfer_fee_charged.definition: A fee was charged on a transfer.
sample_messages: Why was my transfer charged a fee?

beneficiary_not_allowed.definition: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a beneficiary is not allowed.
sample_messages: Why is my beneficiary not allowed?

pending_cash_withdrawal.definition: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending / in progress.
sample_messages: What does it mean when a cash withdrawal is pending?

card_delivery_estimate.definition: How long card delivery takes, delivery by a certain date, expediting card delivery.
sample_messages: How long does it take to get my card?
Can I get my card fast tracked?

unable_to_verify_identity.definition: Identity verification failing or the customer cannot complete it.
sample_messages: The app failed to verify my id.

card_about_to_expire.definition: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring/expired card.
sample_messages: My card is about to expire, how do I get a new one?

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.definition: A cheque or cash deposit was made but the balance has not updated / the funds are not showing or are slow.
sample_messages: I deposited a cheque but I don't see the funds.
My cheque is slow to cash

receiving_money.definition: How to receive money / get paid into the account from others.
sample_messages: Can my friend send me money?

cash_withdrawal_charge.definition: Fees charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
sample_messages: Why did you charge me extra when I withdrew cash?
Is there a fee for ATM withdrawals?
cash_withdrawal_charge.labelling_rule: Fees for cash withdrawals in general. If the withdrawal is abroad, at a foreign ATM or in a foreign currency, choose wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal instead.

lost_or_stolen_card.definition: The card itself was lost or stolen, or found again after being lost.
sample_messages: My card has been stolen.
I lost my card.
